firstPlayerRule: The player who brought the most snacks starts the game.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from that player.
The starter deals each player one Companion card, followed by one Magic Item card, during setup.
internalEvidence: The Z-Man Games English booklet preserved by the LINCC library system was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 128174. Printed/PDF page 3 and the publisher credits on page 11 were rendered and visually checked. Page 3 selects the person who brought the most snacks, says play goes clockwise, and assigns that person the opening card deal. Page 11 identifies Z-Man Games and F2Z Entertainment ©2015. Mirror PDF SHA-256: ae211fe7db4c934764842b945a1fe02f75ec99c39e46af02096fc2248bf5d05f. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: No tie-break or fallback is stated if snack quantities are equal or nobody brought snacks.
